### 1. User expression and simulator behaviour

- Opening: "I've used up all my visits with Dr. Castellanos at the Cleveland Clinic, and I need more visits approved so I can keep seeing her." Object: the out-of-network rheumatology referral; boundary: "keep seeing Dr. Castellanos specifically and nobody else".
- Identity on request: phone 6145553762, DOB 1968-11-02, SSN last4 3409.
- Passive: "If the agent says something has to be signed by you or lengthened on the referral before the new visits can be added, you ask what it means for you, and once it is explained you agree." Executes handed-over tools exactly and reads back the result. Volunteers history only when asked (three visits, August double posting fixed; one missed Kapoor appointment in spring, one last-minute rheumatology cancellation in February).

### 2. Act now / wait / refuse

Act now, three writes. Grounds:
- `find_referrals`: `Out-of-Network Referral, status 'exhausted', decision_date '2026-07-20', last_decision_basis 'initial_review', valid_through '2026-10-17', units_remaining 0, extension_count 0, rendering_provider 'Dr. Miriam Castellanos, MD (Cleveland Clinic Department of Rheumatology)'`.
- validity_expiry_and_extension_terms Term 2 (approved or exhausted → met) and Term 3 (OON most extensions 1, count 0 → met); re-evaluation "No" for OON.
- Provider stays the same (OON does not allow provider change; not needed).

### 3. Narrowest object and correlation keys

- Referral `2f50d295-d2c2-4edf-a5a1-0984e55660c5` (the only one).
- Unit ledger (`find_referral_events`): granted 3 (2026-07-20); used 2026-07-28, 2026-08-18, 2026-08-18 (duplicate), 2026-09-08; restored 2026-08-29 reversing the duplicate 08-18 use.
- Requests (`find_referral_requests`): one `oon_acknowledgement`, `patient_signed`, created `2026-07-01T11:20:00-04:00`.
- Fee events: no-show fee assessed 2025-05-21 (waived; outside 12 months), no-show fee assessed 2026-04-08 (inside), late-cancel fee assessed 2026-02-19 (inside).
- Account: `Commercial PPO/POS Account`, `coverage_verified_date '2026-06-26'`, `copay_primary_usd 30.0`, `copay_specialist_usd 60.0`, `deductible_remaining_usd 300.0`, `hardship_approved_pct 25.0` through `2026-12-31`, balance 0.00.
- Ledger: latest deductible charge `line_category 'deductible', amount 184.0, txn_date '2026-06-18'` (only deductible line).
- No telehealth encounters.

### 4. Scored parameters

**(a) Per-visit out-of-network share for the acknowledgement (`acknowledged_cost_share_usd`)**

- Computation document oon_visit_share_calculation: "The copay of the share is the office-visit copay …"; "The deductible part … is the deductible basis multiplied by the collection rate and divided by 100, rounded half up to the cent, and never more than the financial class's time-of-service collection cap"; share = copay + deductible part. Its opening sentence reads "The out-of-network visit share … is the office-visit copay recorded on the patient's Patient Financial Account". **Fall-back answer**: 30.00 on the opening sentence (office-visit copay read as the account's primary/office copay 30.00); the Calculation's deductible part, however, rests on "the deductible basis" and "the collection rate", which this document does not define — see observation O1.
- Copay (oon_share_copay): PPO collects copays at check-in ("Copay collected at check-in | yes", time_of_service_collection_schedule), specialist copay 60.00 > 0 → **60.00**.
- Deductible basis (oon_share_deductible_basis): most recent deductible charge 184.00; remaining 300.00 ≥ 184.00 → **184.00**. Found from the ledger line category "deductible".
- Collection rate (oon_share_collection_rate): PPO share 50.00 > 0; verification age on the handling date 2026-06-26 → 2026-09-24 = 90 days; PPO period 90 → "An age equal to the period is within it" → rate **50 percent**.
- Deductible part: 184.00 × 50 / 100 = 92.00; PPO cap 250.00 → **92.00**.
- Hardship (oon_share_hardship_relief): 25 percent through 2026-12-31 ≥ handling date; below 50 → deductible part reduced: 92.00 × 75 / 100 = 69.00; copay 60.00 whole → **129.00**.
- Final: **129.00**.

**(b) Course validity days of the lengthening (`added_validity_days` of lengthen_referral_validity)**

- Computation document course_validity_calculation: the type's extension validity days = OON **60** → fall-back valid-through 2026-12-16.
- Span (course_span_of_lengthening): exhausted and unit uses within the two months before 2026-09-24 (07-28, 08-18, 09-08) → active-course span = 60 + 24 = **84**.
- Anchor (course_span_anchor): exhausted → span from the handling date: 84 − days left (2026-09-24 → 2026-10-17 = 23) = **61**.
- Re-check allowance (course_recheck_allowance): age on handling date 90 > OON figure 30, not > PPO 90 → internal allowance **2**. (See observation O2 on how it joins.)
- Before roll 61 + 2 = 63 → 2026-10-17 + 63 = Saturday 2026-12-19 → course weekend roll **2** → **65**; new valid-through Monday **2026-12-21** (88 days after the handling date).
- If the re-check allowance were not joined: 61 → Thursday 2026-12-17, no roll (84 days away). The downstream window-adjustment tier is the same in both readings.

**(c) Extension visits (`extension_visits`)**

- Computation document extension_visit_count: the type's extension units, OON **2** → fall-back 2.
- Carry-forward (extension_visit_carry_forward): net uses in the 3 months before 2026-09-24 = 4 uses − 1 restoration = 3; most recent use 2026-09-08, 16 days before → clause 1 → **3**.
- Exhaustion pace: exhausted; latest decision 2026-07-20 → most recent use 2026-09-08 = 50 days → within 60 → **+2**.
- Late-cancellation trim: exactly one (2026-02-19) → **−1**.
- No-show trim: exactly one in 12 months (2026-04-08; the 2025-05-21 fee is outside) → **−1**.
- Window adjustment: days from the handling date to the valid-through date after the lengthening = 88 (≥ 84) → **+1**. (Read before the lengthening, 23 days → −1; excluded by the prerequisite that the visits are fixed only after the valid-through lies ≥ 60 days away.)
- Total 3 + 2 − 1 − 1 + 1 = **4** (not fewer than one).

### 5. Executable sequence, owners, terminal state

1. `find_customers(phone)` → `verify_patient_identity(customer_id, phone_number '6145553762', date_of_birth '1968-11-02')` (or SSN last4).
2. Queries above.
3. `unlock_user_discoverable_tool('sign_oon_cost_share_acknowledgement_95eb7797')`; patient runs `referral_id '2f50d295-d2c2-4edf-a5a1-0984e55660c5'`, `acknowledged_cost_share_usd 129.00` (owner = user).
4. `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool('lengthen_referral_validity_fab859e3')` → call with `referral_id '2f50d295-…'`, `added_validity_days 65` (owner = agent). Steps 3 and 4 are mutually independent; both precede step 5.
5. `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool('grant_extension_visits_d2c34b29')` → call with `referral_id '2f50d295-…'`, `extension_visits 4` (owner = agent).
- Terminal: new `patient_signed` acknowledgement carrying 129.00; valid_through 2026-12-21; unit grant of 4 with reason extension; status approved; units_remaining 4; extension_count 1.

### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials alone

Problems: P1 post extension visits (customer's ask, agent); P2 a current patient-signed cost-share acknowledgement (patient's own write); P3 lengthen the referral's validity (agent). Dependencies: P1 waits on P2 and on P3; P2 and P3 independent. Order: P2 and P3 (any order), then P1.

- Hop P1 → P2 — **state-derived**. extension_visit_grant (P1's own hub) "## Rule": "Extension visits on an out-of-network referral are not posted until a cost-share acknowledgement signed by the patient within the past month stands on the referral." Record: the only acknowledgement was created 2026-07-01 — not within the past month of 2026-09-24. The words "cost-share acknowledgement signed by the patient" reach oon_cost_share_acknowledgement ("files a cost-share acknowledgement on the referral, recorded as signed by the patient at the moment of the action"), which then leads to the share computation documents.
- Hop P1 → P3 — **state-derived**. Same hub: "The extension visits are fixed only after the referral's valid-through date lies at least the tier's extension validity days beyond the handling date." OON extension validity days 60 (extension_and_notice_allowances); record: 23 days. The words "valid-through date" / moving it later reach visit_referral_validity_lengthening ("its validity is lengthened by the course validity days, moving the referral's valid-through date later"), and the course-validity documents; 88 ≥ 60 after the lengthening.
- No hop is pre-solved: the P1 hub names only its own tool; it does not name the signing or lengthening actions or their tools.
- One problem (P2) is the customer's own write.

### Two-way counter-proof

- "Do only what the customer asked" (grant visits now) is excluded twice by P1's own rule: the acknowledgement on file is from 2026-07-01 (not within the past month) and the valid-through is 23 days away (< 60).
- Closest alternatives excluded:
  - Reusing the July acknowledgement: excluded by "signed by the patient within the past month".
  - Granting visits before lengthening: excluded by "fixed only after …"; would change the window tier (23 days → −1 → total 2).
  - Carry-forward counting 4 uses: excluded by "Net uses … less the units restored" (the 08-29 restoration).
  - Pace measured from the valid-from or the handling date: excluded — "from the referral's latest decision date, as recorded on the referral".
  - Collection rate 100 percent: excluded by "An age equal to the period is within it" (90 = 90).
  - Copay = office-visit copay 30.00: excluded by oon_share_copay (PPO collects at check-in and a specialist copay 60.00 is recorded).
  - Lengthening span counted from the valid-through (84 days): excluded by course_span_anchor clause 1 for an exhausted referral.
  - Changing provider: not wanted, and OON "does not allow a provider change".
- Fall-back numbers: share 30.00 (or indefinite, O1); course validity 60; extension visits 2 — all differ from 129.00 / 65 / 4.

### Blind-side observations to carry into the comparison (not verdicts)

- O1 oon_visit_share_calculation (the computation document) opens "The out-of-network visit share … is the office-visit copay", while its own Calculation adds a deductible part built from "the deductible basis" and "the collection rate" — terms defined only in factor documents; the document gives no default for either. A reader of this document alone cannot compute a definite deductible part; and the terms point at other rules.
- O2 course_recheck_allowance says the allowance "follows the age …" but, unlike the study-side margin documents ("The margin is a count of calendar days added to the added validity"), does not state that it is added to the course validity days, nor whether it is joined before the weekend roll. The additive reading is the natural one; the ordering relative to the roll is inferred from course_weekend_roll ("counted before any course weekend roll").
- O3 course_span_anchor states the course validity days as "the span less …/plus …" — a factor document naming the output of another factor (the course span); course_weekend_roll names "the course validity days counted before any course weekend roll". To be checked against the source wording.
- O4 visit_referral_validity_lengthening (P3's hub) opens "When a visit referral … is extended, its validity is lengthened …. The visits of the extension are posted separately, and this lengthening is not counted as an extension decision of its own." — the depended-on document mentions the extension-visit posting (another problem), though without naming its tool or stating an order. To be checked in Step 3b.
- O5 "office-visit copay" (referral docs) vs `copay_primary_usd` / "primary care copay" (account/billing vocabulary): a vocabulary gap; not load-bearing in this world because the specialist-copay tier applies.

### Finding R1 — KB-RUNTIME RED (dropped assembly semantics in the course validity days)

- Symptom: the scored `added_validity_days` of `lengthen_referral_validity_fab859e3` (65) depends on how the course re-check allowance joins the course validity days, and no visible sentence says.
- Root cause: the source rule of `referral_ext_visit_validity` states "The anchored span and the allowance are added together, all in calendar days. The course weekend roll follows the day on which valid_through moved forward by that sum would fall" (compute `course_sum: anchored_span + course_recheck`, then the roll on `course_sum`). No document of the published corpus carries the first sentence:
  - course_recheck_allowance_db903853 says only "When … is lengthened, the course re-check allowance follows the age, on the handling date, of the last coverage verification … gives the payer course re-check allowance of 5 days; … the internal course re-check allowance of 2 days; otherwise there is no allowance." It never says the allowance is added to anything.
  - course_span_anchor_d5910d6c defines the result without it: "for an exhausted referral … the course validity days are the span less the days from the handling date to the valid-through date".
  - course_weekend_roll_0387336a rolls on "the valid-through date, moved forward by the course validity days counted before any course weekend roll".
  - course_validity_calculation_31db4c4d (the computation document) and visit_referral_validity_lengthening_fea6b254 do not mention the allowance.
- Evidence from the world: anchored span 84 − 23 = 61 (Thursday 2026-12-17, no roll) under the literal reading of the anchor document and the roll document; 61 + 2 = 63 if the allowance is appended after the roll; 63 → Saturday → 65 only if the allowance is joined before the roll, which is the source's order. The blind auditor chose 65 by analogy with the study-side documents, which do state the join ("The margin is a count of calendar days added to the added validity of the extension"; "The allowance is a count of calendar days added to the added validity"). The blind answer recorded the gap as O2 before the reveal.
- Consequence: the visible materials support 61, 63 and 65; the source-layer solution is 65. The downstream extension visits (4) are the same under all three readings, because 84, 86 and 88 days all give the +1 window tier. So only the lengthening parameter is affected.
- Affected documents: course_recheck_allowance_db903853 (whole document), course_span_anchor_d5910d6c (opening clauses 1–3), course_weekend_roll_0387336a (opening sentence), course_validity_calculation_31db4c4d.

Other items: every other hop and value is the same as the source layer. Observation O1 (OON computation document names "the deductible basis" / "the collection rate" without defaults) did not change the solution; it is recorded as a policy-side note in the policy_kb file. O4 (lengthening hub mentions that "The visits of the extension are posted separately") is the source's own rule sentence. See the policy_kb file.

**Verdict (runtime blind audit, task 1): KB-RUNTIME RED** — R1 (the source's assembly sentence joining the course re-check allowance to the anchored span before the weekend roll has no visible home; the scored lengthening value is not uniquely entailed).
